skill.summary: Diagnose a draft for the Curse of Knowledge — the expert blind spot that makes insiders write copy full of unexplained jargon, buried assumptions, strategy-l...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — Diagnose and report Curse of Knowledge issues in drafts for non-expert audiences.

- Detects passages with jargon, abstractions, assumptions, or implied context that can confuse non-experts.
- Requires both draft text and a description of the intended audience to audit effectively.
- Produces a targeted report with flagged violations, reasons, and rewrite guidance (not a full rewrite).
- Suitable for pitches, explainers, announcements, slides, memos, and similar short-form documents.
- Aims to help writers identify and fix expert blind spots before sharing with broader audiences.
